entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Order number is VF-881-92B. I got it about two and a half weeks ago. Just tell me if I can send it back.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order placed on December 15th. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, it's just... hard to use. The pulse tracking interface is incredibly confusing. I read the user manual twice and I just expected more from it. Can I return it or not?
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for this item. One moment, please.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've checked our policy, and I see that your VeloBand is well within the 90-day return window.
90 days? Okay, good. So you're processing the return?
Yes, absolutely. I have just approved it for you. I'm emailing the pre-paid return label to the address we have on file. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes.
Okay. That's what I needed. Thank you.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
